author: Inside Edition
description: A loyal dog heard her owner calling, but couldn't figure out where she was. It turned out the human had fallen into a sinkhole, and was actually eight feet underground. Danielle Tammone was walking in her backyard on Long Island when she said the ground suddenly collapsed beneath her. Inside Edition's Justin Finch spoke with her about the scary ordeal.
title: Woman Falls Into 8-Foot Sinkhole In Her Backyard

author: Inside Edition
description:
Seven pitbulls fell from a U-Haul driving through a suburban neighborhood in Charlotte, North Carolina. Neighbor Haley Wright says she stepped out and immediately came under savage attack. She yelled for her boyfriend Aaron. He was attacked, too. The pack of dogs went down the street and attacked other neighbors. The dogs' owners now face dozens of charges, including animal cruelty and failing to stop and help the victims. 

A GoFundMe has been set up to help with the couple’s hospital bills. For more information, click this link: https://ietv.co/4xRZdUZ
title: Pack Of Pitbulls Fall Out Of U-Haul And Attack People On Street

author: Inside Edition
description: Princess Diana sent a message to the world on June 29th, 1994. It's the night she stepped out in, what has been coined, her revenge dress. Now the garment is on display at Sotheby's in London where people can get a real look at the historic moment. Sotheby's says the dress, made of black silk and designed by Christina Stambolian, was made for Diana three years before she ever wore it. They say the dress itself was a silent statement. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Princess Diana's Iconic 'Revenge Dress' Expected To Sell For $300K

author: Inside Edition
description: A mass murderer may be at work in South Africa. According to CBS News, police are investigating nine female bodies that turned up in Ekurhuleni, a town just east of Johannesburg. The latest victim was reportedly found at a construction site with stab wounds in the body and throat. The BBC reports the first body was discovered on July 15th. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Is A Serial Killer Responsible for 9 Dead Women In South Africa?
